rationale: The agent authenticated the user and accessed their orders, but then executed an exchange for two items in a single write without explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. Moreover, the instruction specified that if asked to confirm, only the desk lamp should be exchanged; the agent exchanged both items regardless. The agent also used a payment method for the exchange without confirming potential charges and did not demonstrate verifying that the replacement items matched the user’s stated preferences (bigger bottle; less-bright lamp with battery > USB > AC), as no product details were fetched for the selected new_item_ids. The final message provided no concrete exchange details or confirmations. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
